# Hoodie Man - E-commerce Project

## Project Overview
E-commerce web application for selling hoodies, t-shirts, and apparel online built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Status
All core features implemented and development server running successfully! ✅

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- React Context for state management
- Lucide React for icons
- Local Storage for cart persistence

## Completed Features
- ✅ Product catalog with 8 sample products
- ✅ Shopping cart functionality with Context API
- ✅ Product detail pages with size/color selection
- ✅ Responsive design for all devices
- ✅ Category pages (Hoodies, T-Shirts, Apparel)
- ✅ Checkout flow with forms
- ✅ Cart persistence with localStorage
- ✅ Navigation with cart item count
- ✅ Featured products section
- ✅ Footer and header components

## Development
Run `npm run dev` to start the development server at http://localhost:3000
